description: Literal byte vectors for the Solana public-decrypt extraData blob — the hand-mirrored codec in kms-connector/crates/utils/src/types/solana_extra_data.rs (encode_solana_public_decrypt_extra_data / parse_solana_public_decrypt_extra_data, Rust) and sdk/js-sdk/src/solana/actions/publicDecryptCertificate.ts (buildSolanaPublicDecryptExtraData, TypeScript). The blob is 0x03 ‖ context_id(32) ‖ encrypted_value_account(32), exactly 65 bytes: the connector fetches the PublicDecryptLeaf proof itself from the coprocessors' leaf record, so nothing but the account the handle lives in travels here. Encoders on both sides must produce blob_hex from input; the strict parser must round-trip every record and reject every malformed entry. All hex is lowercase and unprefixed. Hand-committed literals, deliberately few — the layout is versioned and changes only with a new version byte.

records.name: public-decrypt-v3
records.description: v0x03: version, the 32-byte KMS context id, the 32-byte encrypted value account address.

records.name: public-decrypt-v3-zero-context
records.description: v0x03 with an all-zero context id: the parser reads the fields positionally and gives no byte value a meaning of its own.

malformed.name: trailing-byte
malformed.mutation: one extra 0x00 byte appended — the blob is fixed-width and a longer one is not this layout

malformed.name: truncated-account
malformed.mutation: last account byte removed — a 64-byte blob names no account

malformed.name: context-only-v1
malformed.mutation: the retired v0x01 context-only form — a well-formed blob of another version must be rejected, not defaulted to any account

malformed.name: unknown-version
malformed.mutation: the version byte replaced with 0x09 — the body is otherwise identical and must not be parsed under this layout
